值得閱讀的理由

  • 作者親自挑戰長時間觀看 AI 生成影片，帶來第一手的荒謬觀察與吐槽。
  • 摘要整理出 AI 動畫常見的穿越、系統、逆襲等套路，也指出畫面與劇情上的破綻。
  • 作者從奶奶的觀看習慣出發，探討 AI 內容如何進入日常生活，以及它為何仍能吸引觀眾。

摘要

AI 影片走進家門

作者注意到，YouTube 上充斥著以誇張標題講述動漫或網路小說情節的影片。這類內容從真人旁白、AI 配音，逐漸發展到直接由 AI 生成畫面與故事。原本對這些影片毫無興趣的作者，某次回到祖父母家時，發現奶奶除了看新聞，幾乎只看這類 AI 影片，於是決定用一個晚上親自體驗，弄清楚它們究竟有什麼魅力。

套路滿滿的 AI 動畫

作者點開一部名為《從金色天賦開始複製一切》的作品，先批評縮圖有種黏膩、混濁的「AI 垃圾感」。他觀察到，AI 動畫和漫畫常見套路包括穿越異世界、古裝背景、系統能力，以及主角從困境中翻身。這部作品也不例外：主角穿越後淪為死囚，隨即獲得能複製他人天賦的系統，展開復仇之路。

觀看過程中，作者發現影片只有 360p，畫面也有不少令人出戲的錯誤：半透明系統畫面上的文字沒有反轉，主角卻能直接讀取；角色使出攻擊時看似沒有揮刀，敵人卻倒下；士兵甚至全都長著一模一樣的臉。更令人疲憊的是，故事長達近三小時，劇情漏洞、人物行為與場景位置變化都讓人難以理解。作者形容自己彷彿逐漸被「黑泥」浸透，幾乎失去分辨劇情合理與否的能力。

劇情缺陷與短暫休息

第一部影片裡，主角最後成功闖關，還迎來傲嬌女主角的告白。然而，作者認為 AI 編寫的劇本充滿邏輯漏洞，角色位置也常在鏡頭切換間突然改變，彷彿會瞬間移動。認真思考會令人頭痛，不去思考又容易睡著。於是作者暫停觀看，去玩一款 RPG 遊戲，並順勢介紹遊戲玩法與抽獎活動，短暫逃離漫長的 AI 影片挑戰。

生成技術進步，題材也有看點

接著，作者觀看另一部講述女主角被迫成為直播主、故意說出毒舌真話想搞砸直播，結果意外爆紅的作品。雖然他仍未必認同作品本身，但注意到生成技術已有明顯進步，人物位置與場景邏輯不再像前一部那樣頻繁跳動。這部作品以職場人的處境為切入點，透過女主角想逃離工作、反而因此走紅的反套路設定，創造出新鮮感；作者甚至認為，這個點子拿去向電視台提案，或許也有機會受到青睞。

漫長挑戰仍未說完

到了第三個小時，作者已感到精神幾乎被黑暗吞沒，並用《Fate/Zero》中衛宮切嗣面對聖杯幻象的情節打趣，表示若幻象充滿這種 AI 感，恐怕很難讓人相信。影片接近尾聲時，作者提到自己往下翻閱留言，並準備談觀眾反應；但現有字幕在此中斷，因此無法得知他最後對留言風向的完整判斷。

摘要

反差魅力與告別俗套的健康溝通

作者井川在看完《正相反的你與我》完結篇後，分享了對這部校園戀愛作品的極高評價。本作的核心概念圍繞在「正相反」的特質上，描寫外表亮眼卻體貼的辣妹配上耿直嚴肅的眼鏡男、過度焦慮的少女配上單純樂天的犬系男孩，以及自卑內向少年配上隨和成熟少女等三對組合。故事呈現他們如何克服彼此鮮明的性格差異，逐步走進對方的內心世界。

作者認為這部作品之所以被視為神作，關鍵在於原作者對青春期焦慮的精準刻畫。劇中角色面對人際交往中的摩擦時，不使用老套的誤會或翻舊帳，而是選擇像成熟大人般進行健康溝通。傳統少女漫畫中常拖上五到十集的狗血誤會，在本作中往往撐不過五分鐘便被迅速化解，使得整部作品始終維持著明亮歡快的氛圍。

各具特色的情侶互動與直球魅力

分析劇中的情侶組合時，作者指出這三對皆可視為外向型（E）與內向型（I）的互補搭配。男女主角呈現了典型的男生理性思維與少女細膩感性的碰撞，女主角看似外向開朗卻極度容易想太多，正因為看見男主角能夠毫無保留地展現真實自我而動心；兩人在約會時關注的焦點截然不同，卻在彼此尊重中展現出相互吸引的純粹美好。

作者個人最偏愛的則是第二對組合，這對關係充滿了純真直率的魅力。面對因害怕破壞氣氛而過度小心翼翼、不敢開口的女孩，個性單純的大男孩展現了極高的社交情商與真誠行動。他不僅在關鍵時刻投出毫無遲疑的「直球」主動搭話，更體貼地蹲下平視對方，以一句「失敗了也只是我們兩人的事」卸下對方的防備與恐懼，給予了女方勇於追求自我的龐大勇氣。

反差魅力與告別俗套的健康溝通

摘要

反差魅力與告別俗套的健康溝通

作者井川在看完《正相反的你與我》完結篇後，分享了對這部校園戀愛作品的極高評價。本作的核心概念圍繞在「正相反」的特質上，描寫外表亮眼卻體貼的辣妹配上耿直嚴肅的眼鏡男、過度焦慮的少女配上單純樂天的犬系男孩，以及自卑內向少年配上隨和成熟少女等三對組合。故事呈現他們如何克服彼此鮮明的性格差異，逐步走進對方的內心世界。

作者認為這部作品之所以被視為神作，關鍵在於原作者對青春期焦慮的精準刻畫。劇中角色面對人際交往中的摩擦時，不使用老套的誤會或翻舊帳，而是選擇像成熟大人般進行健康溝通。傳統少女漫畫中常拖上五到十集的狗血誤會，在本作中往往撐不過五分鐘便被迅速化解，使得整部作品始終維持著明亮歡快的氛圍。

各具特色的情侶互動與直球魅力

分析劇中的情侶組合時，作者指出這三對皆可視為外向型（E）與內向型（I）的互補搭配。男女主角呈現了典型的男生理性思維與少女細膩感性的碰撞，女主角看似外向開朗卻極度容易想太多，正因為看見男主角能夠毫無保留地展現真實自我而動心；兩人在約會時關注的焦點截然不同，卻在彼此尊重中展現出相互吸引的純粹美好。

作者個人最偏愛的則是第二對組合，這對關係充滿了純真直率的魅力。面對因害怕破壞氣氛而過度小心翼翼、不敢開口的女孩，個性單純的大男孩展現了極高的社交情商與真誠行動。他不僅在關鍵時刻投出毫無遲疑的「直球」主動搭話，更體貼地蹲下平視對方，以一句「失敗了也只是我們兩人的事」卸下對方的防備與恐懼，給予了女方勇於追求自我的龐大勇氣。

摘要

看似可愛卻極度致鬱的警世之作

作者指出，被譽為超越傳統恐怖作品的警世動畫《FX戰士久留美》正式開播。這部作品表面上披著萌系美少女的精緻外皮，核心卻是一部血淋淋揭露外匯保證金交易（FX）殘酷真相的黑暗故事。主角久留美是一名二十歲的女大學生，她在五年前經歷了一場家庭悲劇，誓言要靠自己的力量賺回家庭失去的兩千萬日圓，為此苦讀了五年交易知識，最終毅然踏入這個充滿高風險且無法回頭的金融世界。

槓桿交易的本質與賭博無異的陷阱

外匯交易看似只是利用各國貨幣匯率波動賺取差價，但真正讓人粉身碎骨的關鍵在於槓桿效應。作者以原作劇情為例，久留美僅憑帳戶內的八十一萬日圓資金，便透過海外券商重倉買進價值高達四千七百八十萬日圓的五十手澳幣對日圓，瞬間開啟了高達59倍槓桿。這種以小博大的交易機制，本質上已脫離了正常理財的範疇，與盲目的高風險賭博完全無異。

愧疚與好勝心驅使的復仇之路

久留美投身外匯市場並非出於對奢華生活的物質慾望，而是源於沉重的罪惡感與不服輸的好勝心。她的母親過去因沉迷交易荒廢家庭，更在二〇〇八年金融海嘯中慘賠兩千萬日圓；當時年幼卻過於早熟傲慢的久留美，一句斥責母親的話成了壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草，導致母親走上絕路。為了在跌倒的地方討回公道，久留美抱著「母女絕對不能輸」的執念進場，展露出如同貪婪幼狼般的極端野心。

形形色色的投資者群像與韭菜宿命

故事中呈現了多種典型的投資風格，包含冷酷算計卻推人入坑的高手、小額跟風賺便當錢的普通韭菜，以及毫無知識只想靠明牌躺平暴富的投機賭徒。然而最諷刺的是，自詡聰明且做好萬全策略的久留美，在數字跳動與貪婪誘惑面前，依然無法自拔地陷入了與母親完全相同的賭徒心態。作者感慨，在資本掛帥的當代社會中，各類轉蛋、投機理財無處不在，人們往往在自認勝券在握的妄想中越陷越深，最終都難逃成為被收割韭菜的命運。

摘要

看似可愛卻極度致鬱的警世之作

作者指出，被譽為超越傳統恐怖作品的警世動畫《FX戰士久留美》正式開播。這部作品表面上披著萌系美少女的精緻外皮，核心卻是一部血淋淋揭露外匯保證金交易（FX）殘酷真相的黑暗故事。主角久留美是一名二十歲的女大學生，她在五年前經歷了一場家庭悲劇，誓言要靠自己的力量賺回家庭失去的兩千萬日圓，為此苦讀了五年交易知識，最終毅然踏入這個充滿高風險且無法回頭的金融世界。

槓桿交易的本質與賭博無異的陷阱

外匯交易看似只是利用各國貨幣匯率波動賺取差價，但真正讓人粉身碎骨的關鍵在於槓桿效應。作者以原作劇情為例，久留美僅憑帳戶內的八十一萬日圓資金，便透過海外券商重倉買進價值高達四千七百八十萬日圓的五十手澳幣對日圓，瞬間開啟了高達59倍槓桿。這種以小博大的交易機制，本質上已脫離了正常理財的範疇，與盲目的高風險賭博完全無異。

久留美投身外匯市場並非出於對奢華生活的物質慾望，而是源於沉重的罪惡感與不服輸的好勝心。她的母親過去因沉迷交易荒廢家庭，更在二〇〇八年金融海嘯中慘賠兩千萬日圓；當時年幼卻過於早熟傲慢的久留美，一句斥責母親的話成了壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草，導致母親走上絕路。為了在跌倒的地方討回公道，久留美抱著「母女絕對不能輸」的執念進場，展露出如同貪婪幼狼般的極端野心。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入剖析警世神作《FX戰士久留美》如何揭示外匯槓桿交易背後的致命風險與人性深淵。
  • 解析女主角久留美與各具代表性的投資角色群像，探討從「理性投資」走向「病態賭徒」的心態轉變。
  • 反思資本主義社會中無處不在的機率陷阱與韭菜宿命，提供現代人極具警示價值的金錢觀啟發。

摘要

看似可愛卻極度致鬱的警世之作

作者指出，被譽為超越傳統恐怖作品的警世動畫《FX戰士久留美》正式開播。這部作品表面上披著萌系美少女的精緻外皮，核心卻是一部血淋淋揭露外匯保證金交易（FX）殘酷真相的黑暗故事。主角久留美是一名二十歲的女大學生，她在五年前經歷了一場家庭悲劇，誓言要靠自己的力量賺回家庭失去的兩千萬日圓，為此苦讀了五年交易知識，最終毅然踏入這個充滿高風險且無法回頭的金融世界。

槓桿交易的本質與賭博無異的陷阱

外匯交易看似只是利用各國貨幣匯率波動賺取差價，但真正讓人粉身碎骨的關鍵在於槓桿效應。作者以原作劇情為例，久留美僅憑帳戶內的八十一萬日圓資金，便透過海外券商重倉買進價值高達四千七百八十萬日圓的五十手澳幣對日圓，瞬間開啟了高達59倍槓桿。這種以小博大的交易機制，本質上已脫離了正常理財的範疇，與盲目的高風險賭博完全無異。

愧疚與好勝心驅使的復仇之路

久留美投身外匯市場並非出於對奢華生活的物質慾望，而是源於沉重的罪惡感與不服輸的好勝心。她的母親過去因沉迷交易荒廢家庭，更在二〇〇八年金融海嘯中慘賠兩千萬日圓；當時年幼卻過於早熟傲慢的久留美，一句斥責母親的話成了壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草，導致母親走上絕路。為了在跌倒的地方討回公道，久留美抱著「母女絕對不能輸」的執念進場，展露出如同貪婪幼狼般的極端野心。

形形色色的投資者群像與韭菜宿命

故事中呈現了多種典型的投資風格，包含冷酷算計卻推人入坑的高手、小額跟風賺便當錢的普通韭菜，以及毫無知識只想靠明牌躺平暴富的投機賭徒。然而最諷刺的是，自詡聰明且做好萬全策略的久留美，在數字跳動與貪婪誘惑面前，依然無法自拔地陷入了與母親完全相同的賭徒心態。作者感慨，在資本掛帥的當代社會中，各類轉蛋、投機理財無處不在，人們往往在自認勝券在握的妄想中越陷越深，最終都難逃成為被收割韭菜的命運。

================================================

To start, let me show you what a real. jumpscare looks like. Hi guys, I'm. Jingchuan. The cautionary tale "FX. Fighter Kurumi" has finally premiered! The legendary horror series that. surpasses Junji Ito—is the real. horror actually just the horror of your. own bank account? Anyway, in today's. video, I want to share with you what I. think makes this series worth watching,. and I'll also touch on some of the. changes made in the anime adaptation. Okay, if you want to know what new. anime are coming out in October, feel. free to check out my fall anime. recommendations. If you like this video. , please consider liking, subscribing,. and leaving a Super Thanks! Alright, 3,. 2, 1—why do people invest? When you. hear this question, I think the answers. are all pretty much the same: to. increase income or to put assets to. more effective use. But—and this is a. big but—why is it so hard to quit. once you start investing? I feel like. this question is the most. thought-provoking theme discussed. throughout the entire "Kurumi" manga. The story follows the protagonist,. Kurumi, a 20-year-old college student. who, five years ago, faced a tragic. event that made her vow to earn back. the 20 million yen her family lost. So,. for those five years, she studied FX. trading every day until, this year, she. was finally fully prepared to dive into. the world of foreign exchange,. embarking on a path of no return. Alright, as you can probably tell, this. show belongs to that "cinnamon roll on. the outside, dark on the inside" genre. —those dark stories wrapped in cute. aesthetics. Like Madoka, Yuki Yuna, or. Mimi-chan, right? First, we need to. understand the nature of FX, which is. what Kurumi focuses on. FX, or Foreign. Exchange, is very simple to understand:. you look at the financial markets and. the fluctuations in currency exchange. rates between countries every day. For. example, maybe today one dollar equals. 101 yen, but tomorrow it might be 103. yen. If you think it will go up, you. buy; if you think it will drop, you. sell. You try to profit from that. exchange rate gap through these trades. Investing like this doesn't seem that. dangerous at first glance, right? Isn't. it just like some of us exchanging. money when the yen is low, preparing. for our next trip to Japan? Can. something like this really lead to. bankruptcy and ruin? Now we must. understand leverage, as it is the core. concept of this series. We will use the.

actual plot of the manga to explain. this. I apologize, as I don't. personally engage in investing, so I. can only relay the story exactly as it. is described in the work. Once, Kurumi. bought 50 lots of Australian Dollar/. Japanese Yen at once. One lot is 10,000. , so that's 500,000 in currency. At the. time of purchase, one Aussie dollar. equaled 95.610 yen, so 95.610. multiplied by 500,000 means she bought. 47.8 million yen worth, compared to. Kurumi. She only actually held 810,000. yen, a full 59-fold difference, which. is equivalent to her using 59x leverage. . Just imagine yourself sitting on one. side of a seesaw, and having to lift. something 59 times your weight on the. other side. That's the feeling. So why. can she do that, buying even when she. doesn't have that much money on hand? This is the unique nature of FX itself; it allows you to trade amounts many. times larger than your actual capital. However, if it were a domestic Japanese. currency broker, they would actually. limit you to a maximum of 25x leverage,. meaning Kurumi could only buy about 20. lots or so. The reason she could buy 50. lots at once is that she used an. overseas FX broker. The work mentions. that after only a few months of. investing, she opened 59x leverage. Honestly, what she is doing is no. different from gambling. I'm not saying. gambling is bad, but don't lie to. yourself that you are investing. This. is the cruel world Kurumi is about to. enter. Having said that, we must. discuss why Kurumi started playing FX,. because you have to know that if "FX. Warrior Kurumi" didn't choose to go. down this dark, cautionary tale route,. it could have been drawn like a shonen. manga: "You and me, let's team up and. get rich through foreign exchange,. aiming to marry a beauty! A heated. money battle is about to begin." It. could have completely been shaped into. a hot-blooded manga, but it wasn't. The. reason Kurumi stepped into the world of. FX is actually because her mother. became addicted to it when she was in. junior high school, subsequently. neglecting her duties as a housewife,. never taking out the trash, never doing. the laundry, and just staring at her. laptop, going crazy all day. To Kuremi,. this looks truly pathetic and miserable. . From this, we can get a glimpse of. her personality: she is an incredibly. sensible child. She is very bright, but. perhaps a bit too bright, which. unintentionally makes her arrogant,. aggressively insisting that if Mom.

can't handle the family's problems, she. will. Mind you, she’s only in middle. school at this point! When her. mother’s investments fail and the. family’s 20 million is wiped out, her. reaction isn't just "Oh no, what do we. do?""Are we going to end up homeless?" Not at all. Instead, what does she say? She says, "Give it to me. I’ll handle. the trading, I’ll earn that 20. million back for you." Yes, and as a. side note, the anime doesn't mention it. , but the manga clarifies that her. mother lost everything due to the. fallout of the 2008 financial crisis. When her mother is completely burned. out and emotionally dead, Kuremi. actually snaps at her, saying, "Who do. you think is responsible for this mess. in the first place?" That sentence. becomes the final straw that breaks the. camel's back, and shortly after, her. mother goes for a free fall—the kind. without a safety rope. This means. Kuremi’s decision to start FX trading. stems from a sense of guilt, not some. wild ambition to get rich quick. Kuremi. doesn't have much interest in luxury or. wealth, which is why even after earning. 800,000, isn't she still continuing to. work part-time at the convenience store. ? This makes it clear: she simply. refuses to lose. I will take back what. was lost exactly where it was lost. There's also this part, where she says,. "I don't want to lose. We, mother and. daughter, absolutely cannot lose." One. of Kuremi’s mentors in investing has. already seen right through her, noting. that her true nature is actually that. of a greedy little wolf. There are four. main characters in the show, each of. them showcasing a different investment. style than Kuremi’s. She is a shrewd. and calculating investment expert with. strategies for both stocks and forex; on the surface, she is a mentor guiding. newcomers, but privately, she has a. cold-blooded side that pushes friends. into the fire. Yasuko with the twin. tails is probably the most relatable " leek" investor like you and me; always. following trends and always taking. small losses, but the point is, they. are just small losses. She doesn't. recklessly use leverage like the. pink-haired or blonde-haired girls; she. mostly sticks to small investments,. satisfied as long as she earns enough. for her daily needs, like adding a soy. egg to her braised pork rice. Finally,. there's the blond guy, Yatsui, who. represents a truly reckless style. Unlike Kumi, who at least spent years. studying and preparing before entering.

the market, Yatsui knows nothing. He. deludes himself into thinking he can. just ask around, invest, and never have. to work a day in his life. He's exactly. like those relatives or elders around. us who blindly join investment groups,. thinking they’ll get rich just by " following the master." Even though he. has managed to stumble out of trouble. by pure luck a few times, he is. undoubtedly the main character most. likely to end up on a fishing boat and. disappear for good. In this battle for. money, the goal has never been to make. a profit; it's about winning. They. crave the sense of achievement that. comes from their own genius-level. calculations, effortlessly watching the. numbers in their accounts multiply. infinitely. However, the most ironic. part is that once Kumi truly steps into. this world, you realize he and his. mother are actually very similar in. many ways, even if he thinks he’s. smarter than her: "I've already planned. a short-term strategy, and I’ve. already decided to quit while I'm ahead. ." Everyone harbors a. bit of wishful thinking, believing that. if they just win that one big wave,. everything afterward will be smooth. sailing. From the moment we jump in, we. are all just "leeks" waiting to be. harvested—it's not a question of if,. but only a matter of when. Because the. more you win, the more you play,. feeling invincible; and the more you. lose, you still......you still keep. playing, because you have no other path. left to take. Right, the author even. posted recently, saying they only just. learned today what "leeks" actually. means in this context, and that it goes. far beyond the traditional sense of. gambling in a casino. This. capital-supremacy society is already. saturated with all kinds of social. games that entrust money to probability. —be it mobile game gacha, claw. machines, or traffic-driven businesses. like celebrities, influencers, manga. artists, and animation studios. And, of. course, there are hundreds, if not. thousands, of investment methods; they. are truly everywhere, and we’ve long. since been unable to escape them. Even. the author is the same. Yes, the.

original creator, dem0n, invests in. real life. If you go browse their X (. Twitter) feed, aside from manga updates. , it’s almost entirely about their. own experiences with buying crypto. For. example, in the inner cover of the. second volume, he wrote about taking. the royalties from the first volume to. buy some unknown, low-value virtual. currency. He said, "I shouldn't have. bought that," clearly having lost money. , and added, "It's supposed to be a big. day for the volume release, so why do I. have to feel so miserable?" Because of. this, netizens jokingly say that what. we are really watching is a story about. whether the author, Kumi, or the. audience will jump into the abyss first. . In this. regard, I’d like to introduce my. recent stress-relief treasure: *. Shin-Bu-Li*. It’s a super healing and. adorable cultivation game. suspense there. 摘要

迷因分級登場

作者 Chuan 開場表示，雖然《BanG Dream!》與《Ave Mujica》因大量迷因而廣受討論，但並非每段有趣片段都適合當迷因，因此這次只挑選具有實際使用情境的台詞與畫面來排名。最早出現的「我從來沒覺得……有趣過」被放進高級，適合用來替各種事情潑冷水；「那又怎樣？」則幾乎能反擊任何質疑，作者認為它非常萬用。

  • 作者以分級榜評選《BanG Dream!》與《Ave Mujica》的迷因，說明哪些台詞最實用、最容易套用。
  • 摘要整理了《MyGO!!!!!》與《Ave Mujica》的代表性名場面，呈現作品如何從劇情發展出迷因文化。
  • 內容也介紹《BanG Dream! 少女樂團派對！》更新後的新模式、演出呈現與尚未動畫化的樂團故事。

摘要

迷因分級登場

作者 Chuan 開場表示，雖然《BanG Dream!》與《Ave Mujica》因大量迷因而廣受討論，但並非每段有趣片段都適合當迷因，因此這次只挑選具有實際使用情境的台詞與畫面來排名。最早出現的「我從來沒覺得……有趣過」被放進高級，適合用來替各種事情潑冷水；「那又怎樣？」則幾乎能反擊任何質疑，作者認為它非常萬用。

經典畫面與《MyGO!!!!!》名句

「一輩子」雖是作品中常見、聽來有趣的詞，卻不太容易融入日常，因此被歸為較難使用的一級。相較之下，俯視角度下的怒視表情連同整個場景都很完整，常被改圖套用在違規或惹人不滿的情境；「我只是愛慕虛榮」及其諧音變體也十分常見。作者則認為「有趣的女人」雖能形容行為古怪的女性角色，變化與用途有限。

「為什麼要演奏《春日影》？」是作者眼中代表《MyGO!!!!!》、甚至足以象徵整部作品的名句。它不只是一句台詞，連歌曲旋律本身也成了迷因：只要有人哼起那段旋律，旁人就可能忍不住發笑。即使台詞不容易放進一般對話，光是突然說出口也自帶效果，因此作者將它列入頂級。

遊戲更新與新故事

談到《春日影》時，作者順勢介紹《BanG Dream! 少女樂團派對！》的新更新。遊戲加入適合新手與老玩家的遊玩選項，以及最多五人同玩的多人模式；角色在首頁與對話場景中的互動、即時反應和鏡頭表現也更細緻，讓演出更有動畫般的臨場感。玩家還能體驗尚未動畫化的樂團故事，包括 Ave Mujica 等新團體的劇情。

作者特別提到 Ave Mujica 的故事風格戲劇性十足：故事涉及一名天才鋼琴家因受同儕排擠而放棄鋼琴，後來在街頭重新找回演奏熱情；另有帶著懸疑與驚悚感的情節，令觀眾看完滿腹疑問。遊戲也收錄多首翻唱曲、不同樂團與成員的互動組合，以及隨季節變化的角色語音，讓粉絲能看到更多角色關係與日常交流。

從 Soyo 台詞到 Ave Mujica 迷因

接著作者盤點一連串由經典對話衍生的迷因。「如果沒有咲……我就……」能套用在各種依賴情境；「只要是我做得到的事……」雖有發揮空間，迷因效果卻不如前後台詞突出。Soyo 質問「你是抱著什麼覺悟說這種話的？」則被列為經典，適合拆穿他人說大話或只顧自己的情況；「只想著……」也能替換成金錢、觀看數等內容，實用性很高。

相較之下，「迷失方向吧」聽起來略帶高高在上的口吻，作者認為它更適合拿來揶揄別人；而「一起迷失吧」則能套用在旅行、初到陌生車站或踏入新遊戲世界等情境，被評為頂級迷因。影片最後開始轉向 Ave Mujica 的迷因，提到「現在，就正式開始吧」這句台詞，但字幕在介紹尚未完整結束時便中斷。

作者指出，許多觀眾對於魯迪烏斯為何在知曉人神不可信後仍選擇迎戰龍神感到不解，這其實源於觀眾已知後續劇情的認知偏差。在魯迪當前的視角中，龍神只是曾將自己身體貫穿擊殺的恐怖強敵，絕非可靠盟友。面對人神挑明其後代未來將與龍神聯手，並以全家性命相威脅的處境，魯迪根本沒有退路；若不遵從人神指示除去龍神，懷有身孕的洛琪希與家人隨時會面臨防不勝防的滅門暗算。

作者進一步分析，魯迪曾試圖約定不讓後代接觸龍神，但人神具備讀心能力且當場回絕，更何況人神的承諾毫無信用可言。依照老魯迪穿越時空帶來的血淚教訓，與人神為敵的代價是魯迪無法承擔的無盡深淵。為了以最高機率守護家人的安全，魯迪只能假設最嚴苛的局面，並非魯莽去送死，而是竭盡全力研發魔導鎧等反制王牌，試圖在勝率極其渺茫的絕境中拼湊出一線生機。
